map_description:
Spaced connected-layout Recon3D fatty-acid map with 140 reactions. The 136-reaction main network retains hard node connectivity through carbon metabolites; currency metabolites are reaction-local. Coordinates are expanded for Escher label clearance. Only the biologically separate extracellular LPS pair and C17:0-CoA desaturation module remain labeled side components. The table-associated C17 desaturases HMR_2288/HMR_2289 retain heptadecanoyl-CoA as a boundary input; optional HPDCAt and FACOAL170 are omitted.
Last Modified Thu Aug 06 2026 13:21:49 GMT+0900 (한국 표준시)

ELOVL5 focus edition (2026-08-07): initial canvas is tightly centered on the ELOVL5-associated fatty-acid synthesis/elongation reactions. The upgraded Escher viewer emphasizes ELOVL5-associated reaction backbones and primary metabolites without changing reaction, node, segment, or flux-mapping identifiers.
